meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 提交并管理云端自动化生物实验流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你是科研人员，想远程运行蛋白质或核酸相关的生物实验。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage biological experiments on an automated cloud lab.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a scientist who wants to run protein/RNA experiments without stepping into the lab.

howto.what: 对照云实验目录介绍协议(用途、读值/结果、价格、周期与状态),并指导准备输入、填表与下单;对于目录外流程,建议用 EstiMate 评估可行性并获得报价。
howto.when: 当你说要跑蛋白表达纯化、HiBiT 或 A280 定量、IVT RNA 合成等实验,或想了解协议选择、输入准备、下单流程时触发。

say.text: 我要做 cell-free HiBiT 表达检测,需要准备什么输入文件?
say.note: 返回该协议的输入格式和费用说明。

say.text: E. coli 表达纯化只测 A280 和加测 LabChip 有什么差别?
SPR 靶点 onboarding 需要哪些前置信息和周期?
say.note: 说明 SPR 方法上线的准备与时限。

howto.what_en: Explains the Ginkgo Cloud Lab protocol catalog (purpose, readout, price, turnaround, status), guides users through input preparation and ordering, and points to EstiMate for custom workflows outside the catalog.
howto.when_en: Activate when the user asks about running Ginkgo Cloud Lab experiments such as protein expression/purification, HiBiT/A280 quantification, IVT RNA synthesis, or about protocol selection, input prep, pricing, and ordering.

say_en.text: I need a cell-free HiBiT assay—what input format and cost are there?
say_en.note: Returns protocol input and pricing details.

say_en.text: What's the difference between A280-only and A280+LabChip for E. coli express+purify?
What prerequisites and turnaround are needed for SPR target onboarding?
